bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:e5978b4f-9c59-.title: Senior Motion Designer
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:e5978b4f-9c59-.description: Bumble's Creative Studio is an exciting inflection point, supporting Bumble Inc.'s portfolio of apps globally. We're looking to hire a Senior Motion Designer to be an integral part of our growing team, working on global projects and across time zones. In this role within the Creative Studio, you'll be responsible for developing effective, exciting, and culturally relevant motion work for our portfolio of brands. You'll be part of a full-service, in-house, geographically diverse creative team of designers, art directors, and copywriters who work hand-in-hand with a global network of producers and external production partners. The Senior Motion Designer is a highly skilled and versatile animator who brings both craft and conceptual thinking to every project. With a strong command of motion design and animation, as well as video editing, they can move seamlessly between briefs, maintaining a consistently high standard of output. They are confident working autonomously as well as collaboratively, bringing proactive energy and fresh ideas to the team, while also playing a key role in helping to shape and formalise how motion shows up across our brands globally. Your creative scope will span a wide variety of work, from global campaigns and social content to cultural brand moments and marketing initiatives, in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. This role is based in New York or Austin, reporting to the Design Director in London.
qualifications: A bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of experience in motion design roles, preferably in the tech sector.

You have an expert command of After Effects and Figma, using the latest design tools and embracing the future; you're comfortable exploring emerging tools such as Cavalry, Jitter, and AI-powered motion tools.
You have a robust portfolio of work that demonstrates strong motion design thinking, exceptional craft and versatile animation skills across digital, social and campaign channels.
You have proven experience developing or contributing to motion guidelines, and an understanding of how to build scalable motion systems for global brands.
You are positive and committed with a 'can-do' attitude and a flexible approach to complex problems, using this to solve into elegant and compelling motion solutions.
You're comfortable working autonomously (delivering design) and in collaboration with others (discovering a solution).
You have great communication skills, both verbal and written, and are confident presenting and explaining your creative decisions to stakeholders.
You thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple briefs and meeting tight deadlines without compromising on quality.
You have excellent time management skills, strong organisational skills and great attention to detail, ensuring our work always communicates clearly and is on brand.
You have solid video editing and post-production skills, with the ability to oversee delivery workflows when needed.
An understanding of audio editing and sound design is a bonus.
Cinema 4D experience is a bonus.
You are passionate about our brand vision and values.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:8faa9536-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion. We pride ourselves on innovative initiatives and thrive in a fast paced and challenging environment. Join our multicultural team of visionaries and industry rebels in disrupting the traditional finance industry! The ideal candidate will be responsible for enabling and ensuring great collaboration throughout the product development cycle of a core strategic platform/capability area, while keeping true to tech, agile, product & design principles. Your job will be to amplify the effectiveness of this complex, cross-disciplinary team, as well as collaborate confidently and translate complex ideas with key stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Data, Marketing, Sales, etc. You are the glue of a happy, productive, cross-functional team; making space for the creative work across all disciplines to happen in a transparent, open environment. The candidate is a top performer who thrives in a very fast-paced and demanding environment, thinks critically, and communicates effectively. Key Responsibilities - Overall roadmap planning: unpack a broad, cross-functional initiative into specific workstreams, help teams define scope, deliverable, and schedules, and coordinate release planning across your team for multiple stakeholders - Create and drive the strategic vision for the product, while also enabling continuous improvement during feature development, ensuring learnings are captured, shared, and integrated. - Manage complex stakeholder relationships who have significant impact on product performance and success. jobgether-jobgether:lever:717c1366-4d2e-.title: VP, Underwriting Manager, Special Risk
jobgether-jobgether:lever:717c1366-4d2e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VP, Underwriting Manager, Special Risk based in United States. This is a senior leadership opportunity within a specialty insurance business focused on complex and evolving Special Risk markets. You will shape the profitability, strategic direction, and long-term growth of a diverse underwriting portfolio. The role combines sophisticated risk selection with portfolio management, partner development, reinsurance oversight, and team leadership. You will work closely with MGUs, TPAs, producers, brokers, and senior internal stakeholders to develop innovative insurance solutions. With significant autonomy and decision-making authority, you will influence outcomes at both the individual account and portfolio levels. The position is ideal for an experienced underwriting leader who brings deep market expertise, commercial judgment, and a strong track record of developing high-performing teams. Travel of approximately 25–30% is expected to support partner relationships, due diligence, and business development activities. Drive department profitability, retention, written premium, and broader business performance goals while maintaining disciplined underwriting practices. Make independent underwriting decisions within established authority levels, ensuring appropriate risk selection, pricing, documentation, and file quality. Develop annual business goals for assigned agents and producers and maintain accountability for their performance and results. Analyze portfolio results, profitability metrics, underwriting performance, and market conditions to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement. Lead and develop a high-performing underwriting team through effective delegation, mentoring, coaching, accountability, and ongoing professional development. Strengthen the team's sales orientation, negotiation capabilities, technical expertise, and effectiveness when representing the organization and managing risk. Maintain current knowledge of market trends, competitive dynamics, emerging risks, and opportunities across relevant specialty insurance segments. Provide technical underwriting guidance across travel, travel medical, blanket accident, and other applicable Special Risk products. Clearly communicate the department's value proposition to brokers, producers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Collaborate with senior leadership on strategic planning, business development, and initiatives supporting long-term growth. Conduct underwriting audits and evaluate portfolio performance against profitability and business-unit objectives, overseeing corrective actions where needed. Participate in due diligence reviews for prospective MGU and TPA partners and support the onboarding of new partners, clients, and accounts. Manage reinsurance relationships and oversee the associated processes to support effective risk management and program structures. Build and maintain strong relationships with MGUs, producers, brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Participate in training programs, business initiatives, and other strategic projects as required. Requirements Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. 15+ years of underwriting experience, with substantial experience managing complex specialty risks and insurance portfolios. Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing underwriting professionals. Demonstrated ability to underwrite submissions applicable to travel, travel medical, blanket accident, and related Special Risk business segments. Strong risk management, analytical, problem-solving, and financial judgment skills. Excellent understanding of specialty insurance products, underwriting principles, market dynamics, and portfolio profitability. jobgether-jobgether:lever:97dc89fa-7a31-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will monitor conversations, trends, memes, and breaking news to identify opportunities for timely and engaging content. The role combines community management, social copywriting, content creation, and hands-on engagement with users and industry voices. You will work closely with marketing and product teams to bring campaigns to life while maintaining a distinctive and authentic brand voice.
